query: No documentation for the WanVideoAddLucyEditLatents node: users can't wire Lucy Edit into a Wan 2.2 5B WanVideoWrapper workflow and get shape errors ('shape [3072, 3072] is invalid for input of size 26214400', 'Expected size 30 but got size 60').

desired.outcome: Confirmed: community-shared full workflow (attached JSON) works; the shape/size-mismatch errors came from the FastWan low-step LoRA — disabling the LoRA (and raising steps to ~50) makes Lucy Edit run fine.
desired.quality: Diagnosis identifies the correct root cause; fix actionable and directionally correct.
